fidelity: instrumented research runtime; ordinary clock; external HID; native beacon feedback

protocol.question: Does the previously fixed three-update compensation remain within one update across phase, early/late position, prediction horizon and concurrent native observation?
protocol.estimator: unchanged 45 increasing beacon updates, at least 30 in 4 s; OLS host REGION receipt; period 10..30 ms/update, max residual <=2 updates
protocol.target: last beacon global update + leadUpdates, then advance 0..3 updates so target office update mod 4 equals the declared residue; declare before send
protocol.endpoint: primary press accepted update; releases and monitor effect retained separately
protocol.loadScope: concurrent host REGION reads, separated by at least 4 ms, during HID setup, deadline wait, contact and final snapshot; no CPU stress, screenrecord or general device-load claim
protocol.stop: stop cohort on missing/ambiguous measurement, unqualified estimator, failed safety check or two measured contacts outside tolerance; retain planned but unrun slots; no retry or compensation tuning
protocol.preparation: fresh research process and Night 1 fixture save for each slot; replay disabled; hashed profile, capabilities, awake/unlocked/charging/<45C, exact APK and Companion 17; original untouched
protocol.cleanup: exclusive lease and bounded commands; stop research and restore original verified menu after every target attempt
notClaimed: separate identification of capture and delivery latency
